# Results walkthrough, all flights: index and provenance

*Generated by `eval/figs_walkthrough_flights.py` at commit `35b22bc`. Stored outputs only (TUMs, bags, dataflash, eval/results json); no estimator run, no simulation; packed bags decompressed to a temporary copy outside ~/thesis_data.*

**Checks:** 44/44 printed-number checks EXACT (rd() string equality, half away from zero; a numbers.md source must also contain the string in the cited line); 104/104 data-identity checks (each plotted curve recomputed from exactly the plotted samples matches its stored scored value).

**Shared code (copied, not imported):** from `eval/figs_thesis.py` by ast, sha256 of each function's source: `cl_clock` `c51082a6061c36b6a26e04437aa96b00dc40ca114f0514139e5b0d6916d1cdbd`; `cl_meta` `d021886cf99ef16aebfec4b7d3dae5644b69b838a0c606558adc90385910183d`; `cl_yaw_err` `4575c5d0bbea13f8a33d57cfd0bcabe790cd223461d6b9d6623ffbb436da7dc7`; `rd` `e7320d3b8f377157c0c6512b2c0b77c978ac309a7130d2729480b786e02589b3`; `rng` `79385088eb16d81efa470d5c0d80a66f325f0beba18d9eb07c1c9bff41347e57`; `sim_path` `a34bfb891c2d308ccb9e22bc1b01022f6e90b13006530d77387955edec8dbbd6`. `aligned()` copied from `eval/figs_thesis_results.py`; `to_NE()` and the frame check from `eval/figs_thesis_drift.py`; the Experiment 4 clock map and error from `eval/o_score.py`.

**Aligned plots (coordinator finding 2026-10-21):** the SE(3) fit of the cruise ATE is degenerate about the corridor axis, so the aligned paths and errors are drawn with a YAW-ONLY alignment (rotation about the vertical + 3-D shift, least squares on the same associated samples in the pinned window); its RMS equals the stored cruise ATE at the displayed 2 dp on every flight (data-identity rows); largest (yaw-only − SE(3)) RMS difference 1.63e-03 m. The SE(3) value is still recomputed to 6 dp as the input-identity check.

**Frame check (1A, unaligned):** heading tolerance 10°; at R5's 2.0 deg tolerance 23/27 pass; the others dsn_tex_r2 UKF -3.00 deg, dsn_tex_r6 UKF -3.47 deg, dsn_tex_r2 FGO -2.69 deg, dsn_tex_r6 FGO -3.04 deg. Any relabel error would give ≥ 90°.

**Why some plots do not start at the origin:** the aligned plots (scoring) show the cruise only (it starts about 30 s after take-off) and each estimate is moved and turned by the best-fit alignment, so its first point is not the take-off point; the unaligned plots start at take-off (0, 0).
